scenes.heading: EXT. RIVER PIER - DUSK
scenes.summary: Mara arrives with a letter; Oren is closing up.

scenes.heading: EXT. THE FERRY - MID-RIVER - NIGHT
scenes.summary: The engine dies in the fog; Mara speaks of her sister.

scenes.heading: EXT. FAR PIER - NIGHT
scenes.summary: A woman waits; Mara steps off; Oren turns back.

characters.name: Mara
characters.description: Thirties, travel-worn coat, carries a suitcase and a letter.

characters.name: Oren
characters.description: Sixties, weathered ferryman in an oilskin coat.

characters.name: The Woman
characters.description: Seen only as a silhouette under a street lamp, face hidden by fog.

locations.name: River Pier
locations.description: A small wooden pier at dusk.

locations.name: The Ferry
locations.description: A small ferry with a coughing engine and a hanging lantern.

locations.name: Far Pier
locations.description: A foggy pier with one street lamp.

styles.name: Fog and Lamplight
styles.description: Muted blue dusk, warm lantern pools, heavy fog.

shots.action: Mara hurries along the wooden pier, suitcase in one hand, letter in the other, as the light fades.
shots.script_line: hurries onto the pier as the light fades

shots.action: Oren coils the rope of the small ferry, in no hurry.
shots.script_line: coils the rope of a small ferry for the last crossing

shots.action: Oren, rope in hand, tells her the ferry is closed.
Mara holds up the letter; Oren reads it, folds it away and says nothing.
shots.script_line: She holds up the letter. He reads it, folds it away, and says nothing.

shots.action: The engine coughs and dies. Fog closes in around the little boat.
shots.script_line: Fog closes in around the little boat.

shots.action: Oren kneels at the engine; Mara's lantern lights his hands.
Mara, lantern raised, looks toward the far shore and speaks of her sister.
Oren nods without looking up from the engine.
A woman stands under a street lamp at the far pier, her face lost in fog.
shots.script_line: waits under a street lamp, her face hidden by the fog

shots.action: Mara steps off the ferry onto the far pier.
Oren turns the boat back into the fog and is gone.
shots.script_line: Oren turns the boat back into the fog.
